metadata.description:
This POAP was given to attendees of the MnTech Tech Leadership Forum on February 23, 2023 discussing Generative AI: Harnessing Disruption into Innovation. Tech Leadership Forums are quarterly educational forums, created by Chief Information Officers for their peers and other C-level tech executives. These morning events provide excellent networking opportunities as well as candid discussions around technology issues, trends and challenges that IT leaders face every day.

This session featured:

Jamie Thingelstad, CTO at SPS Commerce as Host
Todd Van Nurden, Principal Cloud Architect, Microsoft Technology Center, Microsoft
Sam Pierson, CTO at Talend
Tammylynne Jonas, Global CIO, Donaldson
metadata.name: MnTech Tech Leadership Forum: Generative AI
